blocks.text: The 2026-27 NBA season continued Sunday, November 15 (November 14 in the US) with Miami Heat, Chicago Bulls, Memphis Grizzlies, Cleveland Cavaliers and Denver Nuggets scoring victories. Miami Heat beat Detroit Pistons, 137-117 Giannis Antetokounmpo had 34 points, 14 rebounds and eight assists; Klay Thompson scored 26 in his return from an ankle sprain. Bam Adebayo added 20 points, while Davion Mitchell had 15 points and nine rebounds. Cade Cunningham led Detroit with 33 points and eight assists; Kevin Huerter added 20 points and seven assists.
